name: Antigua and Barbuda

flag.description: A red field with a large inverted triangle (a V shape) filled with horizontal bands of black, blue and white from top to bottom; a golden sun with seven rays rises from the black band.
flag.symbolism: The rising sun marks the dawn of a new era, black the African heritage of the people, blue hope and the sea, white the sand, and red the energy of the people; the V shape stands for victory.

hook: Antigua and Barbuda: a golden sun rising out of black, blue and white bands inside a big red V for victory.
trivia: The flag was designed by Reginald Samuel, an art teacher, whose entry won a national competition in 1967.
Antigua is often said to have 365 beaches, one for every day of the year.
